title: Marching Tetrahedra (new-feature): implemented with spatial transforms
abstract: ## Marching Tetrahedra (MT) @paulojamorim @tfmoraes - This PR introduces **Marching Tetrahedra** as a new, stable surface extraction algorithm alongside Marching Cubes. Please review! ### Performance (MRI T1 - Optimal Quality) - **Binary MT:** ~13-15 seconds, 3.5M mm³, 647k mm² - **CA Smoothing MT:** ~161.5 seconds (99.4s algorithm + 62s VTK ops)
